_vim_practice_4: JSON. Exercises are listed in the _exercises array below.
_exercises: 1. Fix the trailing comma errors (hint: search with /,\_s*[}\]])
3. Use f" and ; to hop between quotes on a line, ci" to change a value
4. Use % to jump between matching braces and brackets
5. Use da{ or di[ to delete a whole block or list
6. Use Ctrl-a / Ctrl-x on port numbers
7. Use :g/debug/d to delete every line containing debug
8. Reformat with gg=G, then try :%!python3 -m json.tool
